Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF13835-13836 reads: . MABITA IN LONSISTORIO. SECAETQ DIE XXVI]. SEPTEMS8RIS ANNQ MDCGCLII Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
